diagrams.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: a corrected robotics parameter-identification diagram for a technical article. Image 1 is the old diagram to replace; its Y-to-theta arrow and center-of-mass parameter label are mathematically misleading, so redraw the data flow. Image 2 is a style reference only: opaque white background, thin rounded outlines, restrained pastel blue/purple/orange/green fills, generous whitespace, dark sans-serif labels. Wide landscape canvas, no transparency, no texture. Title: 'Rigid-body parameter identification'. Two clearly separated panels, TRAIN and VALIDATE. TRAIN panel: box 'Training states q, v, a' points to 'Y_train'. Both Y_train and a SEPARATE box 'Measured tau_train' point into 'Fit: scaled QR / SVD'. The fit has one output, 'theta_hat'. VALIDATE panel: 'Held-out states q, v, a' points to 'Y_val'. Both Y_val and theta_hat are separate inputs to a prediction block 'tau_pred = Y_val theta_hat'. That prediction and a separate 'Measured tau_val' box are the TWO inputs to the final block 'r = tau_val - tau_pred'. Validation data must never point back into the fit. Make every arrowhead and operand unambiguous. Keep labels short and verbatim, use simple matrix/vector icons if helpful. Two footer lines: 'Linear inertial coordinates: m, m c, I_O' and 'Accurate prediction does not make every inertia unique.' m c is the first moment, not a standalone center-of-mass coordinate. Do not draw Y producing theta directly; only the fit produces theta_hat. No percentages, fabricated data curves, extra branches, logos or watermark. Keep all text comfortably legible and inside the canvas.
revisions: Edit this diagram with ONE targeted change. Preserve its canvas, white background, all text, formulas, panels, icons, colors and every existing arrow exactly. Add a single thin dark-blue connector from the BOTTOM edge of the upper TRAIN theta_hat box to the TOP edge of the lower VALIDATE theta_hat box. Route it down through the empty space under the upper theta_hat box, left along the open gutter BETWEEN the two panels, then down with a clear arrowhead into the lower theta_hat box. It means the SAME fitted candidate is transferred to held-out prediction. The connector must not touch any other box or resemble validation feeding training. Do not move or resize existing elements. No other edits.
scientific_review: Separate Y and measured torque inputs to the fit
Same fitted theta_hat explicitly transferred into held-out prediction
Both Y_val and theta_hat enter prediction; measured tau_val only enters the residual
Inertial coordinates use mass, first moment and origin inertia; no direct COM coordinate claim
